svg.title: Activity Diagram — Manage Operational Exceptions
svg.desc: Lecturer-style UML Activity Diagram for Manage Operational Exceptions.

g.data-action-name: Facility actor records operational event and doctor/session/release context
g.aria-label: Facility actor records operational event and doctor/session/release context

text.tspan: Facility actor records operational event and

g.data-action-name: Create OPEN OperationalException with approved type and link affected context
g.aria-label: Create OPEN OperationalException with approved type and link affected context

g.data-action-name: Make affected session/release non-bookable and release active ReservationHolds
g.aria-label: Make affected session/release non-bookable and release active ReservationHolds

g.data-action-name: Preserve all confirmed Appointments and identify affected unresolved set
g.aria-label: Preserve all confirmed Appointments and identify affected unresolved set

g.data-action-name: Present affected Appointments and relevant hold/capacity state
g.aria-label: Present affected Appointments and relevant hold/capacity state

g.data-action-name: Offer / secure suitable equivalent alternative after Patient communication using reschedule invariants
g.aria-label: Offer / secure suitable equivalent alternative after Patient communication using reschedule invariants

g.data-action-name: Cancel Appointment from facility side and preserve history
g.aria-label: Cancel Appointment from facility side and preserve history

text.tspan: Cancel Appointment from facility side and

g.data-action-name: Record facility-cancellation outcome with no electronic refund
g.aria-label: Record facility-cancellation outcome with no electronic refund

g.data-action-name: Create documented support escalation for later Platform review
g.aria-label: Create documented support escalation for later Platform review

text.tspan: Create documented support escalation for later

g.data-action-name: Record completed resolution action / outcome for affected Appointment
g.aria-label: Record completed resolution action / outcome for affected Appointment

g.data-action-name: Keep OperationalException OPEN pending escalated resolution; do not close
g.aria-label: Keep OperationalException OPEN pending escalated resolution; do not close

g.data-action-name: Notify affected Patients through Notification Service when required
g.aria-label: Notify affected Patients through Notification Service when required

g.data-action-name: Facility actor requests Close Operational Exception
g.aria-label: Facility actor requests Close Operational Exception

g.data-action-name: Reject closure and identify remaining resolution requirement
g.aria-label: Reject closure and identify remaining resolution requirement

g.data-action-name: Close OperationalException and preserve audit trail
g.aria-label: Close OperationalException and preserve audit trail

g.data-node-name: Every affected Appointment has a completed documented action/outcome?
g.aria-label: Every affected Appointment has a completed documented action/outcome?
